name: Effidence EffiBOT
summary: Four-wheel indoor/outdoor transport robot from France that follows a worker ('follow-me') or drives on its own, carrying up to 300 kg and towing up to 500 kg. The contractor Bouygues trialled it for carrying tools and materials on its sites.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by the French maker Effidence, which has a German-language website and names construction (Baugewerbe) among its applications. Its distributor list names partners in Japan, Singapore, Hong Kong, Canada, Chile, the USA and the UAE plus Effidence & Manitou in France, but no German distributor. No price published.

sellers.name: Effidence
sellers.note: 23 rue de la Roseraie, 63540 Romagnat, France. Sales line and demo booking on the maker site; price on request.

notes: IP54 and rated for outdoor use (maker); handles uneven floors and ramps up to 10 %, but no rough-terrain or stair figure is given.
Options include a gripper, gravity or powered roller conveyor, manual or automatic hitch and a fully custom superstructure.
The maker now markets it mainly for warehouses and factories; the construction use shown is the Bouygues trial.
